class.name: MemoryDatabase
class.brief_description: A [NetwDatabaseBackend] that keeps records in memory.
class.description: Records are lost when the game closes. Useful for tests and prototypes. [codeblock] Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(MemoryDatabase.new()) [/codeblock]

members.member: The name of the in-memory store this backend keeps its records in. Backends with the same [member store] share records.
